name: Puppet Master
description: His table. A card game played across a board in the dark, with him for company. Found, not bought.
author: Anthony Sieben

setup: None. The cartridge sits greyed out in the Library until you find the table another way; then it is yours.
how_it_works: A road of stops with three doors each: tables, card choices, a fire, a stone. Two candles.
At a table: draw, play, offer the lesser things to the greater, ring the bell. Tip his scale.
output: It's a game - no work files. Your place on the road is kept between sessions.
